mapper.select: WITH candidate AS (SELECT id FROM pf.mcp_probe_outbox WHERE state='PENDING' OR (state='PUBLISHING' AND relay_until<clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY created_at,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) UPDATE pf.mcp_probe_outbox o SET state='PUBLISHING',relay_owner=#{owner},relay_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '10 seconds' FROM candidate c WHERE o.id=c.id RETURNING o.id,o.space_id,o.probe_id,o.generation,o.relay_owner

SELECT id,space_id,owner_user_id AS owner_id,ciphertext,nonce,key_version,revision FROM pf.connector_credential WHERE space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{row.ownerUserId} AND id=#{row.credentialId} AND revision=#{row.credentialRevision} AND state='ACTIVE' FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.mcp_probe_inbox(event_id,space_id,probe_id) VALUES(#{publication.id},#{publication.spaceId},#{publication.probeId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.mcp_probe SET state='FAILED',error_code=#{reason},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{publication.probeId} AND space_id=#{publication.spaceId} AND generation=#{publication.generation} AND state='QUEUED'

UPDATE pf.mcp_probe SET state='RUNNING',owner_id=#{owner},fence=#{fence},lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{publication.probeId} AND space_id=#{publication.spaceId} AND generation=#{publication.generation} AND state='QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM pf.capability WHERE id=#{row.capabilityId} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{row.ownerUserId} AND kind='MCP' FOR UPDATE
SELECT coalesce(max(version_number),0)+1 FROM pf.capability_version WHERE space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND capability_id=#{row.capabilityId}
